tracks.title: Before school: morning routine

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 毎朝、何時に起きますか。
turns.english: What time do you get up every morning?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 六時半に起きます。七時に朝ご飯を食べます。
turns.english: I get up at 6:30. I eat breakfast at seven.

turns.speaker: female
turns.english: Do you watch television in the morning?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: いいえ、見ません。八時に学校へ行きます。
turns.english: No, I don't. I go to school at eight.

comprehensionPrompts: What does he do at seven?
Does he watch television in the morning?

tracks.title: After work: evening routine

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 仕事のあと、何をしますか。
turns.english: What do you do after work?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 六時に家に帰ります。七時に晩ご飯を作ります。
turns.english: I return home at six. I make dinner at seven.

turns.speaker: male
turns.english: Do you listen to music at night?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: はい、聞きます。でも、夜はコーヒーを飲みません。
turns.english: Yes, I do. But I don't drink coffee at night.

comprehensionPrompts: What does she do at seven?
What does she not drink at night?
